data.one_liner: Create glassmorphic UI components with frosted glass effects.
data.what_it_does: Provides customized widgets such as GlassContainer, GlassImage, and BlurredImage to easily implement glassmorphism design styles in Flutter apps. Also offers extension methods for blurring images and widgets.
use_when: You want to implement a glassmorphism design language in your app.
You need frosted glass overlays on containers and images.
avoid_when: You need complex UI component sets like full Material or Cupertino widget libraries.
Performance on very old low-end devices is a primary concern with heavy blur effects.
strengths: Easy to use widgets like GlassContainer and GlassImage
Handy extension methods for blurring images and text
Customizable properties including blur, gradient, borders, and shadows
weaknesses: Limited to a specific niche aesthetic (glassmorphism)
Not documented for advanced platform-specific tuning
data.minimal_example:
GlassContainer(
  height: 200,
  width: 200,
  blur: 4,
  color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.1),
  gradient: LinearGradient(
    begin: Alignment.topLeft,
    end: Alignment.bottomRight,
    colors: [
      Colors.white.withOpacity(0.2),
      Colors.blue.withOpacity(0.3),
    ],
  ),
  border: Border.fromBorderSide(BorderSide.none),
  shadowStrength: 5,
  shape: BoxShape.circle,
  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
  shadowColor: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.24),
)
